files.description: Hospital admissions (260 rows): admission_id (whole number), age (years, whole number; about 5% empty), ward (cardiology, oncology, maternity, orthopedics or neurology; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), stay_days (whole number; about 3% empty), charge (two decimals; about 5% empty).

task_text: Fill each missing age with the median age of all admitted patients, then give the mean age per ward (ward names in lower case without extra spaces), rounded to one decimal. `result` should be a Series indexed by ward.
intended_computation: Compute the median of the known ages, use it for the 12 missing ages, clean ward (5 wards) and return the mean age per ward rounded to 1 decimal.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x filling the selected column with the in-place flag does not change the table, so missing ages stay out of the means

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
